data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: WORKTREE-GUIDE.md merge-to-main.sh references updated to reflect the dispatcher pattern and the --strategy flag

## Implementation

File: plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md (modify)

In the "Merging a Worktree Branch to Main" section (around line 647), before the phase table, add a brief note explaining that merge-to-main.sh is now a dispatcher:

"merge-to-main.sh reads `merge.strategy` from `.claude/dso-config.conf` and dispatches to the appropriate implementation:
- `merge-to-main-direct.sh` (default when `merge.strategy=direct`) — 7-phase pipeline above
- `merge-to-main-pr.sh` (when `merge.strategy=pr`) — creates a PR, queues auto-merge, polls CI + review threads"

Keep this concise (3-4 lines max). Do not add a new section — add it as a paragraph before the existing phase table.

## TDD Requirement
Non-executable instruction file — Rule 5 of behavioral-testing-standard.md applies. Structural boundary test only.
Test: `grep -q 'merge\.strategy\|merge-to-main-pr\|merge-to-main-direct\|dispatcher' plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md`
Must FAIL before the change and PASS after.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] merge.strategy mentioned in WORKTREE-GUIDE.md merge section
  Verify: grep -q 'merge\.strategy' plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md
- [ ] merge-to-main-pr.sh or merge-to-main-direct.sh referenced
  Verify: grep -q 'merge-to-main-pr\|merge-to-main-direct' plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Update WORKTREE-GUIDE.md with merge-to-main.sh dispatcher pattern
